victoryPoints.title: Victory points
victoryPoints.description: Casualties and objectives affect victory points. Protect your troops and contest objectives to catch up.

blockedFire.title: Blocked fire
blockedFire.description: Your troops are blocking this battery’s shots. Clear its line of fire so it can shoot.

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: Disorganized units can rout. Pull them out of combat to recover before attacking again.

range.title: Firing range
range.description: Long-range shots deal less damage. Move closer or limit autofire to make your shots count.

flanks.title: Flanks
flanks.description: Flank fire deals more damage. Face the threat and protect your sides with other units.

charge.title: Charges
charge.description: Frontal charges against organized troops are risky. Weaken them with fire or attack a flank.

objectives.title: Small stars
objectives.description: Small stars help replenish your ammo reserve. Capture them to keep your army firing.

ammo.title: Ammunition
ammo.description: Artillery consumes your ammo reserve, which replenishes each turn. Without ammo, it cannot fire. Adjust autofire to conserve ammo.

running.title: Run deliberately
running.description: For most troops, running spends stamina and makes them easier to break if charged afterward. Walk until you need speed or want to charge.

overlap.title: Don't stack units
overlap.description: Overlapping allies move slower, fight less effectively in melee, support each other less, and suffer more organization damage.

terrain.title: Use the ground
terrain.description: Terrain changes movement and combat. Open Info to see a unit's current modifiers and choose suitable ground.

basicsSelect.title: Giving orders
basicsSelect.description: Drag a box over your units to pick them, then drag from the selection to draw where they go. Nothing moves until the turn resolves.

basicsOrderTypes.title: Order types
basicsOrderTypes.description: Every move has a pace. Walk keeps stamina, Run is faster but tires the unit, Fire and Advance shoots while it closes. Open the order menu to switch.

basicsFormations.title: Formations
basicsFormations.description: Formation sets frontage and firepower. Column marches fast, line puts the most muskets forward, square guards every face against cavalry.

basicsSubmit.title: Submitting the turn
basicsSubmit.description: Orders stay queued until you submit. Both armies then resolve at the same time, so plan for where the enemy will be, not where they are.

skirmisherVsArtillery.title: Skirmishers against artillery
skirmisherVsArtillery.description: Enemy battery in your skirmisher's reach. Pour fire into the gun crew. Skirmishers shred unprotected artillery before it can answer.

skirmisherVsCavalry.title: Cavalry near your skirmishers
skirmisherVsCavalry.description: Your skirmisher will be destroyed by enemy cavalry if it keeps that position. Fall back and seek cover.

skirmisherVsInfantry.title: Infantry near your skirmishers
skirmisherVsInfantry.description: Enemy infantry on top of your skirmisher. Skirmishers fold in melee. Pull back before bayonets reach.

infantryFormLine.title: Form line
infantryFormLine.description: Switch these units to line. With enemy infantry in musket range or cavalry coming at the front, line gives you the most muskets pointed forward and the best defence against incoming volleys. Don't form square against a frontal charge, you would lose half your firepower.

infantryVsCavalryFrontal.title: Hold the line
infantryVsCavalryFrontal.description: Enemy cavalry is charging the front of your infantry, but they have orders queued. Clear them so the line stands and fires instead of walking into the hooves.

infantryVsCavalryFlank.title: Form square
infantryVsCavalryFlank.description: Cavalry coming at the flank or rear of your infantry. A line gets ridden over from the side. Form square so every face has muskets out.

infantryBayonetCharge.title: Bayonet charge
infantryBayonetCharge.description: Weak enemy infantry within charge range. Form column and run into them. Bayonet on contact in column breaks them.

infantryFallback.title: Withdraw this unit
infantryFallback.description: This unit's organization has cracked, one more volley and it routes. Pull it out before the line breaks.

infantryVsSkirmishers.title: Infantry against skirmishers
infantryVsSkirmishers.description: Skirmishers are close and no cavalry is available. Advance at a walk and force them into melee, where skirmishers are weakest.

infantryVsArtillery.title: Infantry against artillery
infantryVsArtillery.description: Enemy guns are close and unscreened. Run straight into the crew before they can turn and fire canister.

infantryColumnMarch.title: March in column
infantryColumnMarch.description: No enemies are near this unit. Switch to column for faster marching, then form line before contact.

cavalryVsWeakerCavalry.title: Cavalry against weaker cavalry
cavalryVsWeakerCavalry.description: Enemy cavalry within charge range and shaken, your horse is fresher. Press the advantage: charge before they recover.

cavalryVsEqualCavalry.title: Cavalry against equal cavalry
cavalryVsEqualCavalry.description: Enemy cavalry in contact and roughly as steady as yours. Don't waste stamina on a charge you can't win. Close at a walk and brawl on even footing.

cavalryVsStrongerCavalry.title: Cavalry against stronger cavalry
cavalryVsStrongerCavalry.description: Enemy cavalry in contact and steadier than yours, a melee here loses. Break off and reset before they commit.

cavalryVsInfantryFlank.title: Charge the flank
cavalryVsInfantryFlank.description: Enemy infantry's flank is open and they're roughly as steady as you. That's the moment a clean charge breaks them. Hit the side, not the front.

cavalryVsShakenInfantry.title: Cavalry against shaken infantry
cavalryVsShakenInfantry.description: Enemy infantry is barely holding together, their organization has cracked. One clean charge runs them down before they can rally.

cavalryVsSkirmishers.title: Cavalry against skirmishers
cavalryVsSkirmishers.description: Skirmishers caught in the open with a clear lane to your horse. They fold in melee and can't outrun a charge. Ride them down before they reach cover.

cavalryVsArtillery.title: Cavalry against artillery
cavalryVsArtillery.description: Enemy guns with no screen between you and them. A charge into unscreened crew ends them in one beat. But if a friendly line steps in the way you'll bleed against it instead.

cavalryPursueRouter.title: Pursue the routed
cavalryPursueRouter.description: That enemy is broken and running, with no support to interrupt the chase. A pursuit by cavalry breaks them for good. Finish them before they reform.

cavalryFallbackFromInfantry.title: Cavalry under musket fire
cavalryFallbackFromInfantry.description: Your cavalry is sitting in musket range of healthy line infantry. Pull back before they grind down your horse, look for shaken targets or open flanks instead.

enemyInfantrySquare.title: Enemy square
enemyInfantrySquare.description: Enemy infantry has formed square. Every face has muskets out. Keep your cavalry away and look for line or column targets with a flank to exploit.

artilleryFireAndAdvance.title: Fire and advance
artilleryFireAndAdvance.description: The enemy is far enough away that you can keep closing while you fire. Switch this artillery to Fire and Advance.

artilleryRotateToFire.title: Stop to fire
artilleryRotateToFire.description: The enemy is close and your cannon has a clean shot, but it is still moving. Stop the march and rotate the unit onto the target so autofire can work.

idleUnits.title: Units without orders
idleUnits.description: Some of your units have no orders this turn. Give them one, or they will stand still while the rest of the line moves.

pushObjective.title: Press your lead
pushObjective.description: You hold the lead. Push toward the enemy objective. Closing it out denies them any comeback.

holdObjective.title: Hold your objective
holdObjective.description: You're behind on points. Pull back to your objective and hold it. Defending is cheaper than retaking.

mixedOrderDescription: Each unit keeps its own order type.
autofireMaxAmmoWarning: At long range, damage is minimal but you still spend ammo. Use it only if you know what you're doing.

battleOverview.pressureExplanation: How does pressure affect the score?
battleOverview.scoreExplanation: How is the score worked out?
battleOverview.scoreExplanationBody: Every team starts from the same base. Objectives add the victory points of the ones the team holds. Losses move points from the team that has lost more of its army to the team that has lost less, so one team's gain is the other's loss. The percentage under a total compares that team with the average of all teams.
battleOverview.title: Battle Overview
battleOverview.timeUnderPressureTooltip: Time under pressure is the time a team holds <0>{{percentage}}%</0> of the objective VPs or less. While under pressure, a team loses <1>{{vpPerTurn}}</1> VP per turn.

hudHelp.overview: Open the battle overview. Victory points reflect casualties and objectives.
hudHelp.selectDivision: Select units still waiting for orders, or the whole division when all have orders. Double-tap or double-click to centre the map.
hudHelp.selectUnit: Select this unit. Double-tap or double-click to centre the map.
hudHelp.formation: Apply this formation to selected units that support it.
hudHelp.orderType: Choose the order the next map drag gives the selection.

orders.1: Choose walking for the next movement order.
orders.2: Choose running for the next movement order.
orders.3: Choose a shooting order and then its target.
orders.4: Advance while firing; melee units walk instead.
orders.7: Change the direction the selected units face.

commands.supplyView: Show or hide supply lines on the map.
commands.drawLine: Draw a line to rearrange one complete brigade or division, or to place multiple groups and units.
commands.smartCurvedMovements: Switch between direct movement and curved routes.
commands.rotateContinuous: Tap for a quarter turn. Hold to rotate continuously.
commands.multiSelect: Add units to the current selection.
commands.tools: Show or hide additional battle tools.
commands.tactics: Choose formations and autofire settings for selected units.
commands.ping: Mark a location on the map.
commands.playerButton: View the players and their teams.
commands.info: Inspect the selected unit or objective.
commands.menu: Open battle settings and exit options.
commands.nextIdle: Select a unit without orders. If none remain, cycle through available units.
commands.submit: Submit your orders for this turn. Once sent, they cannot be taken back.
commands.remove: Clear the orders of the selected units.

select.mouse: Click one of your units to select it. The marked unit is a good place to start.
select.touch: Tap one of your units to select it. The marked unit is a good place to start.

deploy.mouse: Right-click open ground inside your deployment zone to place the selected unit. You are arranging your army before the battle.
deploy.touch: Tap open ground inside your deployment zone to place the selected unit. You are arranging your army before the battle.

deployReady.mouse: Unit placed. You can arrange the rest, or press Submit orders to start the battle.
deployReady.touch: Unit placed. You can arrange the rest, or press ✓ to start the battle.

move.mouse: Right-click open ground to set a destination. The arrow previews the movement; the unit waits for you to submit.
move.touch: Drag from the unit to open ground to set a destination. The arrow previews the movement; the unit waits for you to submit.

submit.mouse: Movement prepared. You can give more orders or press Submit orders below. Both armies then move at the same time.
submit.touch: Movement prepared. You can give more orders or press ✓ below. Both armies then move at the same time.

unitComparison.title: Compare units
unitComparison.baseValues: Base values, before terrain, formation and condition modifiers; not a combat prediction.
unitComparison.relativeTo: Percentages show this unit’s difference relative to {{unit}}.

battleContinuation.title: Continue battle
battleContinuation.description: Start a new offline battle from this position. Scores restart; the full replay keeps the original actions.
battleContinuation.scenarioHint: The scenario is editable. The battle file also preserves the replay.
battleContinuation.chooseHuman: Choose a human player with surviving units.
battleContinuation.error: Could not load or save this battle. Please try again.

matchAcceptance.firstRejection: No loss or Elo penalty. Declining or missing another offer within 24 hours will restrict fast ranked matchmaking for 2 minutes.
matchAcceptance.restriction: Repeated declined or missed offers. Fast ranked matchmaking is restricted for {{minutes}} more min. Private and offline games remain available.
matchAcceptance.restrictionEnded: Your restriction has ended. You can search again.
matchAcceptance.rules: A fast ranked battle starts when every player accepts. Abandoning then counts as a normal loss, even on the first turn, without an extra automatic ban. Declining or missing received offers within 24 hours results in a warning, then 2, 10 and 60-minute restrictions, capped at 60 minutes. Declines do not cost Elo.
matchAcceptance.waiting: Accepted. Waiting for the other players…
matchAcceptance.error: Could not confirm your response. Please try again.
matchAcceptance.requeued: Another player did not confirm. You are back in the queue with your waiting priority preserved.
matchAcceptance.noLoss: This offer ended without a loss. You can search again.
matchAcceptance.failed: We could not confirm whether the battle was created. Check before searching again.
